population.span: The study enrolled adults with moderate to severe nonpsychotic depression and a history of nonresponse to at least two antidepressants in the current episode, with one antidepressant assessed prospectively.

endpoint.span: change from baseline to day 28 in Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) score

estimate.span:
RESULT OUTCOME 0 DENOM Participants: Intranasal Esketamine (Esk) Plus Oral Antidepressant (AD)=101; Intranasal Placebo Plus Oral AD=100
RESULT OUTCOME 0 MEASUREMENT : Intranasal Esketamine (Esk) Plus Oral Antidepressant (AD)=-21.4 (spread 12.32); Intranasal Placebo Plus Oral AD=-17.0 (spread 13.88)

analysis_set.span: Full analysis set (FAS) defined as all randomized participants who received at least 1 dose of intranasal study medication, 1 dose of oral antidepressant (AD) medication during double-blind induction phase (D-BIP).

treatment_strategy.span: Confirmed nonresponders were randomly assigned to treatment with esketamine nasal spray (56 or 84 mg twice weekly) and an antidepressant or antidepressant and placebo nasal spray.

follow_up.span: Of 435 patients screened, 227 underwent randomization and 197 completed the 28-day double-blind treatment phase.

absent_reason: ci: Neither the held abstracts nor registry reports a confidence interval for the observed-case raw between-arm mean difference. The reported intervals concern MMRM or ANCOVA least-square mean differences.

candidate_rejections.span: Change in MADRS score with esketamine plus antidepressant was significantly greater than with antidepressant plus placebo at day 28 (difference of least square means=-4.0, SE=1.69, 95% CI=-7.31, -0.64)
candidate_rejections.why: MMRM least-square mean difference and its interval cannot supply the CI for the served observed-case raw mean difference.

candidate_rejections.span: Difference of Least Square (LS) Means -3.5 (95% CI -6.67 to -0.26) | p =0.034 | METHOD ANCOVA
candidate_rejections.why: ANCOVA analysis uses the endpoint with last observation carried forward; its adjusted estimate and CI do not match the served observed-case raw analysis.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Entry required adults with depression and nonresponse to at least two antidepressants in the current episode.
entry_population_matches_question.span: The study enrolled adults with moderate to severe nonpsychotic depression and a history of nonresponse to at least two antidepressants in the current episode, with one antidepressant assessed prospectively.

notes: Registry spans are accepted for arm summaries and FAS. The registry separately states 'RESULT OUTCOME 0 DISPERSION TYPE: Standard Deviation'. Served means, SDs and denominators match those summaries. No raw MD or CI was calculated. The endpoint name supports MADRS change at Day 28; observed-case terminology is not explicitly stated. Set-aside concerns the missing matching CI, not trial eligibility.
